title: Initial loop host configuration
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose the forward and find-mode settings, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. The loop host's initial configuration on $x$ equals the capture configuration of the relocated fuel machine's initial configuration, with the fuel state embedded into the host control states and empty capture buffers.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines B and F
replaced:
For every input word $x$, the initial configuration of the loop host on $x$ equals the
capture embedding (with empty capture buffers and return phase zero) of the initial
configuration of the relocated fuel source on $x$.
